newsitem.title: CHINA: SOCCER-CHINESE CHAMPIONS MAKE IT FIVE WINS FROM FIVE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CHINESE CHAMPIONS MAKE IT FIVE WINS FROM FIVE.

text.p: Defending champions Dalian Wanda maintained their 100 percent record in the Chinese league on Sunday by beating Qingdao Hainiu 1-0.
Dalian's victory was their fifth in their first five games of the season and stretched their unbeaten record to 39 matches.
Their closest rivals Shanghai Shenhua beat Chinese army side August First team 4-0 thanks largely to a hat-trick by Xie Hui. They remain four points off the lead.
Shanghai won the league title in 1995 and finished second last year.
Third-placed Guangzhou Apollo held northerners Tianjin Lifei to a goalless draw while Sichuan Quanxing won 2-0 against Guangdong Hongyuan to go fourth.
Brazilian Marcelo Marmelo de Silva opened the scoring for Sichuan in the 74th minute and Yao Xia added a second six minutes later.
De Silva, in his third season with Quanxing, chested down a pass in the middle of the pitch and dribbled into the penalty area before beating goalkeeper Ou Chulian with a low shot.
In other matches played on Sunday, Jinan Taishan recorded their first win of the season by beating Yanbian Aodong 1-0 while Vanguards Huandao held Beijing Guo'an to a goalless draw.
